verdict.rationale: Wave's public GraphQL endpoint answers an unauthenticated introspection query, so a machine-readable schema (the GraphQL equivalent of an OpenAPI spec) appears to be retrievable. That probe was a single query, though: no full schema was pulled, and no vendor documentation could be cited because the developer portal returns 403. All candidate OpenAPI paths return 404. missing for 10: a documented downloadable spec file, a full schema retrieval verified hands-on, first-party docs describing the spec or introspection access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: a live Apollo GraphQL server with introspection enabled
